overview.zh: RQX-59G 32GB采用Jetson AGX Orin 32GB模块，配备GMSL2相机接口，不带扩展箱。本条目对应料号93-45R03-1110，避免把不同内存、相机与机箱配置混在一起。
overview.en: RQX-59G 32GB uses a Jetson AGX Orin 32GB module, GMSL2 camera interfaces, and no expansion box. This record corresponds to 93-45R03-1110, keeping memory, camera and enclosure configurations separate.

overview.zh: 这类控制器集成计算模块、通信、电源与结构，不是完整机器人。相机同步、驱动版本、CAN隔离、温度条件和选配扩展需要随订货料号确认，不能直接把NVIDIA裸模块的最大算力或接口数套到整机上。
overview.en: These controllers integrate compute modules, communications, power and mechanics, not a complete robot. Confirm camera synchronization, driver versions, CAN isolation, temperature conditions and expansions against the ordering code. Bare-module peak compute and interface counts do not automatically apply to the system.

verification.zh: 判断：系统级I/O与同步可减少载板开发工作，但交付仍需验证传感器端到端时延、长期供货和具体机型的持续负载。
verification.en: Assessment: system I/O and synchronization can reduce carrier-board engineering, but delivery still requires sensor latency, lifecycle supply and sustained-load validation.

Confirm camera synchronization, driver versions, CAN isolation, temperature conditions and expansions against the ordering code. overview.zh: 这类控制器集成计算模块、通信、电源与结构，不是完整机器人。相机同步、驱动版本、CAN隔离、温度条件和选配扩展需要随订货料号确认，不能直接把NVIDIA裸模块的最大算力或接口数套到整机上。
overview.en: These controllers integrate compute modules, communications, power and mechanics, not a complete robot. Confirm camera synchronization, driver versions, CAN isolation, temperature conditions and expansions against the ordering code. Bare-module peak compute and interface counts do not automatically apply to the system.

applications.zh: AMR感知、移动设备控制与机器人系统集成
applications.en: AMR perception, mobile-machine control and robot-system integration

integration.zh: 确认所选镜像的JetPack、Ubuntu与相机BSP版本，以及点火控制、接地、线缆锁紧、散热风速和扩展卡功耗。数据手册的验证条件不得简化成无条件环境保证。
integration.en: Confirm JetPack, Ubuntu, camera BSP, ignition control, grounding, cable locks, cooling airflow and expansion-card power. Datasheet test conditions are not unconditional environmental guarantees.

verification.zh: 判断：系统级I/O与同步可减少载板开发工作，但交付仍需验证传感器端到端时延、长期供货和具体机型的持续负载。
verification.en: Assessment: system I/O and synchronization can reduce carrier-board engineering, but delivery still requires sensor latency, lifecycle supply and sustained-load validation.

alt.zh: RQX-59系列官方产品外观，具体扩展箱以型号为准
alt.en: Official RQX-59 family image; expansion-box configuration depends on model

type.zh: 机器人与工业边缘计算控制器

overview.zh: RQX-590 64GB采用Jetson AGX Orin 64GB模块，订货表中SerDes为N/A，不带扩展箱。本条目对应料号93-45R03-010E，避免把不同内存、相机与机箱配置混在一起。
overview.en: RQX-590 64GB uses a Jetson AGX Orin 64GB module, SerDes marked N/A in the ordering table, and no expansion box. This record corresponds to 93-45R03-010E, keeping memory, camera and enclosure configurations separate.

overview.zh: 这类控制器集成计算模块、通信、电源与结构，不是完整机器人。相机同步、驱动版本、CAN隔离、温度条件和选配扩展需要随订货料号确认，不能直接把NVIDIA裸模块的最大算力或接口数套到整机上。
overview.en: These controllers integrate compute modules, communications, power and mechanics, not a complete robot. Confirm camera synchronization, driver versions, CAN isolation, temperature conditions and expansions against the ordering code. Bare-module peak compute and interface counts do not automatically apply to the system.

applications.en: AMR perception, mobile-machine control and robot-system integration

integration.zh: 确认所选镜像的JetPack、Ubuntu与相机BSP版本，以及点火控制、接地、线缆锁紧、散热风速和扩展卡功耗。数据手册的验证条件不得简化成无条件环境保证。
integration.en: Confirm JetPack, Ubuntu, camera BSP, ignition control, grounding, cable locks, cooling airflow and expansion-card power. Datasheet test conditions are not unconditional environmental guarantees.

verification.zh: 判断：系统级I/O与同步可减少载板开发工作，但交付仍需验证传感器端到端时延、长期供货和具体机型的持续负载。
verification.en: Assessment: system I/O and synchronization can reduce carrier-board engineering, but delivery still requires sensor latency, lifecycle supply and sustained-load validation.

type.zh: 机器人与工业边缘计算控制器

overview.zh: RQX-71G T5000采用Jetson T5000、128GB LPDDR5X与128GB系统SSD。该规格书同时列出DLAP-711和RQX-71G：前者不列GMSL2相机，后者为八路GMSL2。两者的供电栏不同，应按具体列核对。
overview.en: RQX-71G T5000 combines Jetson T5000, 128GB LPDDR5X and a 128GB OS SSD. The datasheet covers DLAP-711 and RQX-71G: GMSL2 cameras are absent from the former and eight channels are listed for the latter. Their supply columns differ and must be checked separately.

overview.zh: 这类控制器集成计算模块、通信、电源与结构，不是完整机器人。相机同步、驱动版本、CAN隔离、温度条件和选配扩展需要随订货料号确认，不能直接把NVIDIA裸模块的最大算力或接口数套到整机上。
overview.en: These controllers integrate compute modules, communications, power and mechanics, not a complete robot. Confirm camera synchronization, driver versions, CAN isolation, temperature conditions and expansions against the ordering code. Bare-module peak compute and interface counts do not automatically apply to the system.

applications.zh: AMR感知、移动设备控制与机器人系统集成
applications.en: AMR perception, mobile-machine control and robot-system integration

integration.zh: 确认所选镜像的JetPack、Ubuntu与相机BSP版本，以及点火控制、接地、线缆锁紧、散热风速和扩展卡功耗。数据手册的验证条件不得简化成无条件环境保证。
integration.en: Confirm JetPack, Ubuntu, camera BSP, ignition control, grounding, cable locks, cooling airflow and expansion-card power. Datasheet test conditions are not unconditional environmental guarantees.

verification.zh: 判断：系统级I/O与同步可减少载板开发工作，但交付仍需验证传感器端到端时延、长期供货和具体机型的持续负载。
verification.en: Assessment: system I/O and synchronization can reduce carrier-board engineering, but delivery still requires sensor latency, lifecycle supply and sustained-load validation.

type.zh: 机器人与工业边缘计算控制器

overview.zh: DLAP-711 T5000采用Jetson T5000、128GB LPDDR5X与128GB系统SSD。该规格书同时列出DLAP-711和RQX-71G：前者不列GMSL2相机，后者为八路GMSL2。两者的供电栏不同，应按具体列核对。
overview.en: DLAP-711 T5000 combines Jetson T5000, 128GB LPDDR5X and a 128GB OS SSD. The datasheet covers DLAP-711 and RQX-71G: GMSL2 cameras are absent from the former and eight channels are listed for the latter. Their supply columns differ and must be checked separately.

overview.zh: 这类控制器集成计算模块、通信、电源与结构，不是完整机器人。相机同步、驱动版本、CAN隔离、温度条件和选配扩展需要随订货料号确认，不能直接把NVIDIA裸模块的最大算力或接口数套到整机上。
overview.en: These controllers integrate compute modules, communications, power and mechanics, not a complete robot. Confirm camera synchronization, driver versions, CAN isolation, temperature conditions and expansions against the ordering code. Bare-module peak compute and interface counts do not automatically apply to the system.

integration.zh: 确认所选镜像的JetPack、Ubuntu与相机BSP版本，以及点火控制、接地、线缆锁紧、散热风速和扩展卡功耗。数据手册的验证条件不得简化成无条件环境保证。
integration.en: Confirm JetPack, Ubuntu, camera BSP, ignition control, grounding, cable locks, cooling airflow and expansion-card power. Datasheet test conditions are not unconditional environmental guarantees.

verification.zh: 判断：系统级I/O与同步可减少载板开发工作，但交付仍需验证传感器端到端时延、长期供货和具体机型的持续负载。
verification.en: Assessment: system I/O and synchronization can reduce carrier-board engineering, but delivery still requires sensor latency, lifecycle supply and sustained-load validation.

overview.zh: 这类控制器集成计算模块、通信、电源与结构，不是完整机器人。相机同步、驱动版本、CAN隔离、温度条件和选配扩展需要随订货料号确认，不能直接把NVIDIA裸模块的最大算力或接口数套到整机上。

Confirm camera synchronization, driver versions, CAN isolation, temperature conditions and expansions against the ordering code. Bare-module peak compute and interface counts do not automatically apply to the system.

overview.zh: 官网标注于2026年1月9日停产的16GB Xavier 控制器，保留旧系统维护身份。官网与其链接的2020年规格书在电源附件、重量和中间件名称上不一致，分别保留，不组合成未经提供的配置。
overview.en: 16GB Xavier controller marked discontinued on9 January2026, retained for legacy-system support. The website and linked2020 datasheet differ on power accessory, weight and middleware; values are kept separate rather than combined into unoffered configurations.

role.zh: 工业边缘计算与机器人控制平台供应商
role.en: Industrial edge-compute and robot-control platform supplier

overview.zh: 凌华科技于1995年成立，总部位于桃园，官网披露自2002年起以6166代码上市。其业务覆盖工业计算、嵌入式模块、GPU计算、医疗、交通与机器人，不是单一机器人整机厂。
overview.en: ADLINK was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Taoyuan. Its website states that it has been publicly traded as 6166 since 2002. The portfolio spans industrial computing, embedded modules, GPU systems, medical, transport and robotics applications, rather than one complete-robot category.

overview.zh: 机器人控制器当前重点包括Jetson AGX Orin平台RQX-59，以及初步规格状态的RQX-31G和Thor平台RQX-71G。料号间的内存、相机SerDes、扩展机箱与输入电源存在差异；供应商统一系列名称不能代替具体型号清单。
overview.en: Current robotics controllers include Jetson AGX Orin-based RQX-59 and preliminary RQX-31G and Thor-based RQX-71G products. Memory, camera SerDes, expansion enclosures and input supplies differ by part number; a family name cannot replace a configuration list.

overview.zh: 除硬件外，公司提供BSP、相机驱动及感知集成服务。RQX-59参考平台支持相机与LiDAR同步和传感器融合，官方相机推荐表包含TIER IV、Stereolabs、oToBrite、Leopard和Orbbec等品牌；这些相机可直接向原厂采购，不应全部登记为凌华自行制造。
overview.en: Beyond hardware, ADLINK provides BSPs, camera drivers and perception-integration services. The RQX-59 reference platform supports camera/lidar synchronization and sensor fusion. Its camera list includes TIER IV, Stereolabs, oToBrite, Leopard and Orbbec; those cameras can be purchased from their original vendors and are not all ADLINK-manufactured products.

overview.zh: 公司公开强调版本、质量、信号完整性和生命周期管理，产品周期条款随协议变化。针对机器人，重点应是外设同步、散热下的持续运行、BSP维护与替代料计划；集团收入不能直接映射到ROScube销量。
overview.en: The company describes revision, quality, signal-integrity and lifecycle management, with lifecycle terms varying by agreement. Robotics evaluation should focus on synchronization, thermally sustained operation, BSP maintenance and replacement-part planning; consolidated revenue does not directly establish ROScube shipments.

businessAreas.zh: 机器人控制及感知集成

customerGroups.zh: AMR、人形机器人与服务机器人企业
工业、车载与传感器系统集成商

catalogScope.zh: 控制器以模块、内存、SerDes与扩展箱区分配置，外购相机不改写制造商。
catalogScope.en: Controllers are separated by module, memory, SerDes and expansion enclosure; external cameras retain their manufacturer identity.

investmentView.zh: 判断：工业接口与BSP整合是系统供应商的价值之一，但版本维护、传感器兼容和环境测试也带来持续工程成本。应结合合同和分业务披露评价，不能仅用生态伙伴数量推算业绩。
investmentView.en: Assessment: industrial I/O and BSP integration add value but also require continuing version maintenance, sensor validation and environmental testing. Evaluate contracts and segment disclosures rather than inferring results from partner counts.

detail.zh: 公司官网将1995年列为起点。
detail.en: The corporate history records 1995 as its start.

detail.zh: 官网披露股票代码6166，2002年起公开交易。
detail.en: The website records public trading since 2002 under code 6166.

scope.zh: 本轮保留20个旧身份及全部字段；当前共56条。已读规格表逐项入库，访问失败、来源冲突和未披露分开列示。
scope.en: All 20 previous identities and fields retained; 56 records now. Readable specification tables transcribed; access failures, source conflicts and non-disclosure are separate.

gaps.reason: Official manual-download endpoint timed out twice at30 seconds; current April2026 two-page datasheet is cached and transcribed in full. No manual pinout is invented.

ROScube-X2 EOL2026-01-09;RQX-580/58G EOL2026-03-01. X2 webpage vs2020 PDF differ on160/280W adapter, weight, DDS;RQX58 controller/kit PDFs differ on M.2 key names. TIER IV C1 optional camera part numbers are TBD, so no invented ADLINK camera SKU.

RQX-31G/RQX-71G preliminary limits and RQX-71G9-36V versus24V source discrepancy remain. No independent extended-environment report, exact BSP lifecycle contract or financial allocation to these robotics products was disclosed in the reviewed materials.

Current NSDK page links manual Rev1.0 dated2021-04-14. All readable capability/configuration tables are version-qualified; Foxy/Ubuntu20.04 and old shared-memory limitations are not asserted to describe an undocumented newer release.
